title: Notes can be opened only with a mouse: rows are plain li elements with a click handler
evidence: app.js:10 renders li without tabindex or role, and app.js:30-33 listens only for click. A li is not focusable, so Tab skips every note. styles.css:6 also removes the focus outline.
failing_case: A keyboard user loads the page with 3 notes. Only the first opens (app.js:51). Tab goes search, New note, title, body. There is no way to open note 2 or 3. WCAG 2.1.1 (A).
remediation: Render each row as a <button> (or li containing a button) with the title as its name, use aria-current for the active row, and keep the delegated click handler.

title: Note title is put into innerHTML unescaped (stored XSS)
evidence: renderList builds an HTML string from n.title, which comes from the title input and from localStorage. Driven in Chromium: a note titled fired alert(1) on creation and again after reload.
failing_case: Type in the title field, wait 500 ms, reload: the handler runs on every page load, because the title is persisted and re-rendered. Any script can then read or rewrite all notes.
remediation: Build the list with createElement and textContent (or escape on every interpolation); never concatenate stored text into HTML.

title: Delete is a non-focusable div with no name, and deletes without confirm or undo
evidence: Driven: no li or .del has tabindex or role. Notes open only by mouse click on a li. The control is invisible (opacity 0) until mouse hover (styles.css:12). Clicking it removes the note and its text at once.
failing_case: A keyboard or screen-reader user can neither open a note from the list nor delete one (WCAG 2.1.1, 4.1.2). A mouse user who mis-clicks the bin loses the note permanently.
remediation: Render each row as a button (to open) and a real <button aria-label="Delete note: title"> that is also visible on :focus-within; add a confirm or an undo toast; announce the result.

title: maximum-scale=1 blocks pinch zoom
evidence: The viewport meta caps the scale at 1 on mobile browsers that honour it (iOS Safari does for pinch gestures only in some versions, and Android Chrome does).
failing_case: A low-vision user on a phone can't enlarge the page. This is a WCAG 1.4.4 (AA) failure, and it makes the 12px hint and the grey list ranks unreadable.
remediation: Remove maximum-scale (and any user-scalable=no).

title: Title and body fields have no accessible name; search uses only a placeholder
evidence: index.html:19-20 have no label, aria-label or placeholder. index.html:13 gives the search box a placeholder only. The note list and the save hint have no live region.
failing_case: A screen reader announces 'edit text' / 'edit text multi-line' for the editor fields. The placeholder disappears once the user types in the search box. The WCAG 1.3.1 / 4.1.2 / 3.3.2 criteria fail on the main editing path.
remediation: Add visible <label for> for title and body, and a label or aria-label on search. Put the hint in an aria-live=polite region that reports saved or failed.

title: Unguarded JSON.parse at load: one bad value bricks the whole app
evidence: Driven with stored values: '{bad' throws SyntaxError in store.js, so store.js never defines the rest and app.js fails with 'notes is not defined'; '{}' gives 'notes.filter is not a function'; '[null]' gives "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'title')". In each case the list is empty and no control works.
failing_case: localStorage 'notes' is truncated or edited to '{bad'. The page loads blank forever; the user has no way to recover or export, and the first successful save would overwrite what was there.
remediation: Parse inside try/catch, check Array.isArray and each record's fields, keep the raw string under a backup key on failure, tell the user, and store a schema version.

title: Debounced save writes to whatever note is current when the timer fires, and crashes when none is
evidence: scheduleSave captures nothing at schedule time. Driven: (a) first run with no note, typing in the title throws "Cannot set properties of null (setting 'title')" in the timer and nothing is stored; (b) edit note 2's body to AAA, click note 1 within 500 ms: the timer saves note 1's fields and the AAA edit is gone (notes show body "" for both); (c) delete the open note, then type: same TypeError, editor still shows the deleted note's text.
failing_case: Open the app with no notes, type a title in the editor. Nothing is saved, the page shows no error, and the hint still says "Changes save automatically". Or: type in note B, click note A within half a second; B's edit is dropped.
remediation: Capture the note id at schedule time (or flush the pending save inside openNote/removeNote before switching), skip when no note is open, and disable the editor until a note exists.

title: Failed writes are swallowed while the UI says changes save automatically
evidence: persist() ignores every setItem error. Driven with setItem throwing QuotaExceededError: no error, the hint still reads "Changes save automatically", nothing is stored.
failing_case: Storage is full or blocked (private mode). The user writes pages of text, sees no warning, closes the tab, and loses all of it.
remediation: Return success or failure from persist, show a visible, announced error with a next step (export the note, free space), and keep the data in memory.

title: Fixed 1200px container and 300px list column: sideways scroll below 1200px and unusable on a phone
evidence: styles.css:2 sets a hard width and styles.css:7 a fixed 300px first column. There is no media query anywhere. The textarea height is also fixed (400px).
failing_case: At 390px the page is 1200px wide: a horizontal scrollbar appears and the hero, search and editor are mostly off-screen. At 200% zoom on a 1360px screen the effective viewport is 680px with the same overflow (WCAG 1.4.10 reflow).
remediation: Use max-width: 1200px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box. Below about 700px switch .layout to one column (grid-template-columns: 1fr).

title: Focus outline removed from every control with no replacement
evidence: styles.css:6 removes the outline on buttons, inputs and the textarea. Nothing else sets :focus-visible, box-shadow or border colour. The input border is #eee on white.
failing_case: Tab through the page. The focused search box, title, body and New button look identical to the unfocused ones. This is a WCAG 2.4.7 (AA) failure.
remediation: Delete the rule, or replace it with a :focus-visible style of at least 2px and 3:1 contrast against the background.

title: Rank text, save hint and editor border fail contrast
evidence: Computed ratios on white: #bbb 1.92:1 (rank, line 11), #ccc 1.61:1 (.hint, line 15), white on #8b5cf6 hero gradient end 4.23:1, white on #6366f1 button 4.47:1 (line 5, under 4.5). The hint is also 12 px.
failing_case: The 'Changes save automatically' message is almost invisible to low-vision users (WCAG 1.4.3, AA).
remediation: Use text colours of at least 4.5:1 (for example #595959 on white) and a darker button or hero fill.

title: Clicking a shared result throws: it has no data-id
evidence: app.js:46 renders <li class="shared"> without data-id. The delegated handler matches any li, so Number(undefined) is NaN and openNote(NaN) sets currentNote to undefined (app.js:17), then app.js:18 throws.
failing_case: Search, wait for a shared result, click it. The console shows 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading title)', nothing opens and currentNote is now undefined, so later edits throw too.
remediation: Give shared rows their own handler or ignore li.shared in the delegated handler, and make openNote return when the id is not found.

title: Shared-note rows break the click handler, and out-of-order or failed responses corrupt the list
evidence: Shared <li> elements have no data-id. The delegated click handler (app.js:30-33) matches any li, so Number(undefined) = NaN reaches openNote, where notes.find returns undefined. app.js:18 then throws a TypeError, and currentNote becomes undefined. Separately, the search handler awaits fetch with no abort and no ordering check, no res.ok check, and appends to whatever the list is when it resolves.
failing_case: Search 'a' then 'ab' quickly. If the 'a' response lands after renderList('ab') and after the 'ab' response, both result sets are appended and the stale shared rows show up as duplicates. A 500 response with a JSON error body makes shared.map fail. Clicking any shared row throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading title)', and the editor stays stale while currentNote is undefined.
remediation: Ignore click on non-local rows (or give them a distinct handler). Keep a request counter or AbortController and apply only the latest response. Check res.ok and Array.isArray. Render the shared rows through the same list builder.

title: scheduleSave dereferences currentNote when there is none (first run, after delete)
evidence: currentNote starts null (store.js:3). The editor is live from first load, and app.js:36-37 attaches scheduleSave to input with no guard. removeNote sets currentNote = null (app.js:26) but leaves the old text in the editor.
failing_case: First run: type in the title box. 500 ms later the timer throws 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null' and the text is never saved. Same after deleting the open note: the editor still shows its text, edits throw, nothing saves.
remediation: Return early when currentNote is null, disable the editor until a note is open, and clear and disable the fields on delete.

title: List is not re-rendered after a save, so titles and ranks go stale
evidence: The save timer in store.js updates the note but never calls renderList. Driven: renamed a note to 'Renamed'; the list still read 'Untitled' with rank #1.
failing_case: Rename the open note: the sidebar keeps the old title and the '#rank' badge (which depends on the updated time) is wrong until some other action re-renders.
remediation: Call renderList from the save callback, or render from a single state change function.

title: Delete is immediate with no confirm and no undo
evidence: removeNote calls deleteNote and persist at once (app.js:23-28, store.js:29-32). The target is an unlabelled emoji that sits directly beside the row's click area.
failing_case: A slight mis-click on the 🗑 while aiming at a row permanently removes the note and its body from localStorage. There is no way back.
remediation: Add an Undo toast (keep the note in memory for several seconds, announce it) or a confirm that names the note.

title: Shared-search responses are appended without checking they are still current; failures are invisible
evidence: Driven with a delayed first response: typing 'a' then 'ab' left both 'shared-a' and 'shared-ab' in the list while the box shows 'ab'. res.ok is never checked and res.json() on an error page throws into console.log only. Each keystroke also fires a request with no debounce or abort.
failing_case: Type quickly: results for older queries appear under the current one. If the server returns 500 the user sees no shared results and no message.
remediation: Use an AbortController (or a sequence number) so only the latest response renders, check res.ok, debounce the input, and show a 'shared notes unavailable' state.

quote: const sorted = notes.slice().sort((a, b) => b.updated - a.updated);
title: renderList copies and sorts all notes inside the per-note loop, then does innerHTML +=
evidence: Cost is O(n^2 log n) per render plus the quadratic re-parse of innerHTML +=, and it runs on every keystroke in the search box. Measured: renderList takes 62 ms at 100 notes, 1195 ms at 500, 5437 ms at 1000; a 2000-note store made page load exceed 30 s.
failing_case: A user with 500 notes types one character in Search and the page freezes for over a second per keystroke.
remediation: Sort once outside the loop and build a rank map, then build the list in a DocumentFragment and assign once.

quote: const note = { id: Date.now(), title: 'Untitled', body: '', updated: Date.now() };
title: Date.now() ids collide; deleting one note deletes both
evidence: Driven: two clicks on New in the same millisecond produced ids [1793258036921, 1793258036921]. deleteNote filters by id, openNote uses find, so the second note is unreachable and delete removes the pair.
failing_case: Double-click New (or script/automation, or two tabs): two notes share an id. Opening the second opens the first; deleting either removes both with their text.
remediation: Use crypto.randomUUID() or a counter checked against existing ids, and de-duplicate on load.

quote:
✨ Welcome to NoteMaster

Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, your notes, supercharged.
title: Placeholder lorem ipsum ships in the hero, inside a default-template hero (Welcome to, sparkle, indigo to violet gradient)
evidence: index.html:11 shows lorem ipsum text to every user. styles.css:3 uses the indigo to violet gradient (#6366f1 to #8b5cf6) and styles.css:1 the Inter typeface. The hero takes 60px padding top and bottom for a tool the user opens to write.
failing_case: Every visit starts with 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet' as the page copy, and the hero pushes the editor down by about 200px.
remediation: Delete the hero or reduce it to a compact app header. Write real copy or none. Pick a deliberate palette and face for this product.
